items.description:

items.headline: Wind Advisory issued November 13 at 5:31AM AKST until November 15 at 6:00AM AKST by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
* WHAT...East winds 20 to 30 mph with gusts up to 45 mph expected.

* WHERE...Prince of Wales Island.

* WHEN...From 6 PM Saturday to 6 AM AKST Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Winds will begin to increase during the day
Saturday, reaching at least 45 mph during the evening timeframe.
Forecast confidence is increasing strong wind gusts will then
continue into Sunday.
items.instruction: Winds this strong can make travel difficult. Use extra caution.

items.headline: Special Weather Statement issued November 13 at 5:24AM AKST by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
Moderate snow and winds are expected along the Central Brooks
Range from from early Saturday morning through Saturday night.
Total snow accumulations could range between 2 and 5 inches during
this time frame. Localized gusty winds could produce areas of
blowing and drifting snow alongside reduced visibility especially
along Dalton Highway Summits. Travel may become difficult
throughout this period.

items.headline: Special Weather Statement issued November 13 at 5:24AM AKST by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
Moderate snow and winds are expected along the Central and Eastern
Brooks Range from early Saturday morning through Saturday night.
Total snow accumulations could range between 2 and 5 inches during
this time frame. Localized gusty winds could produce areas of
blowing and drifting snow alongside reduced visibility especially
along Dalton Highway Summits and for areas further east. Travel
may become difficult throughout this period.

items.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued November 13 at 5:04AM AKST until November 13 at 11:00PM AKST by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Snow. Total snow accumulations up to 7 inches.

* WHERE...Kodiak Island Southwest.

* WHEN...Until 11 PM AKST this evening.

* IMPACTS...Travel could be difficult.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...The highest snow accumulations are more likely
towards Shelikof Strait, particularly Larsen Bay and Karluk.
items.instruction:
Slow down and use caution while traveling. For the latest road
conditions call 5 1 1 or visit 511.alaska.gov.

items.headline: Dense Fog Advisory issued November 13 at 4:58AM AKST until November 13 at 10:00AM AKST by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Visibility as low as one quarter mile in dense fog.

* WHERE...Glenn Highway from Eureka east to Glennallen and Richardson
Highway from Gulkana south to the Edgerton Highway.

* WHEN...Until 10 AM AKST this morning.

* IMPACTS...Hazardous driving conditions due to low visibility.
items.areas: Eureka / Tahneta Pass; Western Copper Valley; Central Copper Valley; Ernestine; Southern Copper Valley
items.instruction:
A dense fog advisory means visibilities will frequently be reduced to
less than one quarter mile. If driving, slow down, use your
headlights, and leave plenty of distance ahead of you.
